headlines.headline: NBA SAYS NO EVIDENCE BALLMER FUNNELED MONEY TO KAWHI LEONARD AMID CLIPPERS SCANDAL
headlines.detail: The Clippers' Kawhi Leonard/Aspiration saga took another turn Monday as the NBA said it has found no evidence owner Steve Ballmer funneled money to Leonard through sponsors, contradicting an earlier ESPN report. Draymond Green re-signed with Golden State (1 yr, $27.7M); Suns center Mark Williams agreed to a three-year, $38 million deal.

headlines.headline: COWBOYS LAND VON MILLER AS VIKINGS' JAMAL ADAMS SUFFERS SEASON-ENDING INJURY
headlines.detail: Dallas agreed to terms with eight-time Pro Bowl pass rusher Von Miller Sunday. Vikings safety Jamal Adams suffered a season-ending quadriceps injury Saturday vs. the Giants, and Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (high ankle sprain) is unlikely to play again this preseason.

headlines.headline: NOTRE DAME, OHIO STATE INK BLOCKBUSTER JERSEY-PATCH DEALS AS FALL CAMPS OPEN
headlines.detail: Notre Dame signed a SoFi jersey-patch deal worth an estimated $18-20M annually; Ohio State followed with a roughly $17M-per-year Chase Bank deal. Ohio State confirmed OL Austin Siereveld, Phillip Daniels and S Earl Little Jr. are fully cleared for camp.

headlines.headline: TRANSFER PORTAL CHURN CONTINUES INTO MID-AUGUST AS 1,400+ PLAYERS STILL IN MOTION
headlines.detail: More than 1,400 players remain in the men's basketball transfer portal (roughly 59% committed). Guard Skyy Clark and forward BJ Edwards are among the latest commitments as Kentucky, USC and Arizona continue reshaping rosters.
